name: 10532 · Hawthorne, NY
findings: ZIP 10532 (Hawthorne) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (70%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10532 (Hawthorne) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10532 (Hawthorne) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.8 times the typical level).
